scope: Local implementation of sub-slice S2c-2 of docs/QR_3_FAIR_COMPARISON_CONTRACT.md (RC-C37 to RC-C43, RC-C45) for PM-1 row F10-02: four result tables join the uninstalled QR-3 comparison install (evaluations, benchmarks, outcomes, replay events), each insert-only, SERIALIZABLE only and guarded by named checks; the outcome is tied to the stored evaluations and to the COMPLETE status event of the same transaction; the owner reader applies the same checks; the grant script lists the four tables as insert-only. Nothing is installed on staging and no route, worker or view writes the tables.
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the S2c design and root decided RC-C37 to RC-C43. A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote S2c-2; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed rounds 1 and 2; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each of three rounds. Root ruled on every finding, including the UNAVAILABLE rule in round 3. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module of the three slices of this wave (found with git grep): 54 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (804 tests, 0 fail; 3 skipped by environment gates in files this wave did not change: one non-loopback address check and two TEMP-privilege suites), the full unit suite (2150 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test. Two later test-only assertions (one QR-3 reader case and one S3b import-scanner case) were checked by an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) with their target mutations, both killed. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: quant-comparison-results 20 of 20, quant-comparison 19 of 19 (dump and restore included) and quant-comparison-create 12 of 12 pass with 0 skipped; the PostgreSQL grant test passes with the four tables.

mutations.round1: 5 killed, 1 equivalent (a create-transaction clause shadowed by the status guard of the same name).
mutations.round2: 8 killed, 1 equivalent; the reader cross-check of the body comparison id and spec hash is not killed by any test (see limits).
mutations.round3: 5 of 6 killed; the survivor (UNAVAILABLE without a stored row) became a test and was killed in the later check.

limits: The reader check that the evaluation body names the same comparison and spec is not proven by a test; a table CHECK already ties those body fields to the columns. That tie therefore rests on the evaluation body CHECK alone, and the reader cross-check beside it is not proven by any test.
The outcome value SINGLE_QUALIFIED_RESULT stays absent while owner item OPEN-2 is open.
A grant reapply is needed after the install; no install was run on any environment.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted S2c-2 as local engineering evidence for F10-02. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
